title: Four starter selectable frames readability and Unit09 anatomy correction
summary: Audited four user-provided 1774x887 RGBA starter sheets (front, left, right, back each). View heights vary within each sheet by only 2-11px, useful for consistency, but 295k-343k distinct RGBA values and soft partial alpha on >99.9% of visible pixels show these are high-resolution 32-bit-STYLE references, NOT clean limited-palette native sprites. At 96px diagnostic sizes, armor details disappear; silhouette, visor color and mantle/ponytail carry identity. Independently rebuilt elongated hips/thighs/knees/shins/boots on earlier original Unit09 study (128x216 to 128x262, binary alpha); proportions improve yet armor/boots remain crude, so artistic quality gate FAILS. Next lock runtime pixel scale, establish one full-body native static art benchmark, check four-view foot anchors and test selectable characters at actual game scale before animation. User-supplied images never copied to public warehouse.
